ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a circulation schematic diagram, with “Jia” marked at the lower left, “Bing” marked at the upper left, “Yi” marked at the lower right, and “Ding” marked at the upper right. The top ① airflow goes from left to right, the right-side ② airflow goes downward, the bottom ③ airflow blows from near Yi on the right side toward near Jia on the left side, and the ④ airflow above Jia on the left side is an upward ascending branch. Then reason: If this figure represents the East Asian summer monsoon circulation, the near-surface summer monsoon should blow from the ocean toward the continent. In the figure, the bottom ③ airflow blows from the Yi side toward the Jia side, so the left side where Jia is located can be judged to be the continent side with stronger heating. In summer the continent is strongly heated, and air rises over the continent due to thermal action; in the figure, the airflow located above Jia and indicating ascent is numbered ④. Therefore the one rising due to thermal action is ④ airflow.

method.method_draft: 先看图：底部③气流从乙一侧吹向甲一侧，符合东亚夏季近地面风从海洋吹向大陆的特征，因此甲所在左侧代表受热较强的大陆。夏季大陆热力作用强，空气在大陆上空上升；图中甲上方左侧的上升支标为④，所以因热力作用上升的是④气流。
